rule.name: BufferNeverReleased
rule.message: This reference-counted buffer is allocated, retained or encoded here and only read in the method: it is never released, returned, stored or handed to another call, so its memory (direct memory for pooled Netty buffers) leaks until the process runs out. Release it on every path: a try block with buf.release() in its finally, or hand it to the pipeline (ctx.write(buf)) or return it. An exception fits an unpooled heap buffer, which the garbage collector frees.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $allocators := ('buffer', 'directBuffer', 'heapBuffer', 'ioBuffer', 'compositeBuffer', 'compositeDirectBuffer'), $reads := '^(get|set|read|write|is|has|can|skip|index|bytes|ensure|capacity|readable|writable|equals|hashCode|toString|refCnt|clear|mark|reset|order|max|forEach|compareTo)', $fluent := '^(write|set|clear|mark|reset|skip|ensure|discard)', $shares := 'Slice|Retained|Duplicate|Sink|Readonly', $allocates := function($init) { exists($init[self::MethodCall] [(@MethodName = $allocators and (*[1][self::MethodCall][@MethodName = 'alloc'] or *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBufAllocator')] or *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('io.netty.buffer.Unpooled')][../@MethodName = 'directBuffer'])) or (@MethodName = ('retain', 'readRetainedSlice', 'retainedSlice', 'retainedDuplicate') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf')]) or (matches(@MethodName, '^encode') and pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf'))]) }, $onlyRead := function($u) { ($u/parent::MethodCall[*[1] is $u][matches(@MethodName, $reads)][not(matches(@MethodName, $shares))] [parent::ExpressionStatement or not(matches(@MethodName, $fluent))]) or ($u/parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('equals', 'compareTo', 'writeBytes', 'setBytes')]) } return //LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator [VariableId[pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf')]] [$allocates(*[2])] [let $name := VariableId/@Name, $scope := ancestor::Block[1] return every $u in $scope//VariableAccess[@Name = $name] satisfies $onlyRead($u)]
